notes.title: August 5, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Here is the list of changes and fixes from the August 5, 2025, maintenance. 
 
[b]Seasonal Events[/b] 
 
- Fae Yule is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of Fae Yule. 
 
- Autumn Harvest is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of the Autumn Harvest. 
 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
 
- Prismatic Planar Earrings and Prismatic Planar Earrings buffs for all callings now behave correctly when the character dies and respawns. 
(Previously, the buffs would disappear upon death, and the player would need to re-equip the earrings to allow the buffs to activate once more.) 
 
- The new capes from the July 22, 2025, patch are no longer dyeable. 
(When trying to dye the primary dye channel of any of the capes, the textures would disappear.) 
 
- Adjusted some images that looked distorted in the RIFT store. 
 
- Resolved an issue with the Object Distance setting not applying correctly. 
(RIFT’s object distance regulates itself with RAM usage, depending on the user’s machine capabilities – with this change, we have effectively increased the overall limit before RIFT self-regulates and reduces the object distance to favour smooth performance over pretty graphics. 
 
For low-end machines, Object Distance will continue to work as it has till now. 
Higher-end users will now see higher Object Distance more often due to the increased RAM limit usage cap – assuming the setting is set to the maximum of 180) 
 
[b]New Items[/b] 
 
Three new Ursin mounts and four new Tiger mounts have been introduced. 
These mounts will become available in RIFT in the following weeks. 
 
We thank you for your continued support! 
Your RIFT team [/p]

notes.title: Dimension Contest: Ascended’s Haven!
notes.content:
Hello, Ascended! 
Welcome to the Dimension contest: Ascended’s Haven! 
 
This month’s contest is all about you, where you are challenged to build your perfect safe place, a place where you yourself would spend hours of time in and is also a place that lets your personality shine through! 
 
[b]How do I participate? [/b]
 
1. Get into RIFT and pick any of your favorite dimensions. 
2. Decorate your dimension with the concept of building your very own safe place. 
3. Take one or more screenshots or your creation and submit it in the #Ascended-Haven channel on the official RIFT Discord server or use the #RIFTAscendedHaven hashtag on X or Facebook 
4. Be sure to include Character Name, Shard, Region and Dimension Name with your entry. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing dimension, however, do note that fresh and new decorations are always encouraged. 
2. Your entry must adhere to the theme of your own safe haven. 
3. Content that may be inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden. 
4. Image editing is allowed as long as the entry is vastly visible. 
5. Not including a Character Name, Shard, Region or Dimension Name will make you ineligible to receive a reward. 
 
[b]What are the rewards?[/b] 
 
The top three (3) participants will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits  
2nd place – Dimension Contest Second Place + 2000 Credits  
3rd place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 1000 Credits 
 
The entry period will conclude on June 6, 2025, 10:59 PM UTC and winners will be announced on June 13, 2025.

The Dimension theme suggestion form is still open! 
If you have any fun ideas for a dimension contest, be sure to leave your suggestions there!

notes.title: RIFT’s Month of Love
notes.content:
Hello, Ascended! 
Love is in the air, and we are no stranger to celebrating the month of love with you with some lovely activities! Starting today, join in the Lovely Dimension Contest to create the most charming dimension across Telara and/or capture a screenshot with your loved one for a chance to win fantastic prizes! 
 
[b]Dimension Contest: A lovely Home[/b] 💖🏡
 
This month’s dimension contest is all about crafting the most delightful dimension where love can blossom. Pink? Hearts? Up to you, just make it lovely! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]
 
1. Select your favorite RIFT Dimension. 
2. Decorate the dimension following the theme of love. 
3. Capture one or more screenshots of your dimension and submit them to the #lovely-home-2025 channel on Discord or use the #RIFTLovelyHome2025 on Facebook or X. 
4. Don’t forget to include your Character Name, Shard and Dimension Name with your entry. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing Dimension, however, keep in mind the fresh decor is encouraged! 
2. Your entry must adhere to the theme of Love. 
3. Any content that may be offensive or inappropriate is not allowed. 
4. Image editing is allowed, as long as the entry remains vastly visible. 
5. Not including Character Name and Shard with your entry will make you ineligible to receive a reward. 
 
[b]What are the rewards? [/b]
 
The top three (3) participants will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st Place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits 
2nd Place – Dimension Contest Second Place + 3000 Credits 
3rd Place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 3000 Credits 
 
Entry period will close on March 3, 2025, 22:59 UTC and winners will be announced on March 11, 2025. 


[b]Screenshot Contest: A Lovely Duo 💞[/b]
 
If dimensions are not your style, then worry not, we have something for you and your loved one to take part in as well! 
 
Take part with your significant other to conquer Telara through sheer power of love and win amazing rewards! 
 
[b]How do I participate?[/b] 
 
1. Head over to Telara with your loved one. 
2. Pick out your favorite attire, matching or not, show us your personalities! 
3. Strike a pose and take a screenshot! 
4. Submit your entry to the #lovely-duo-2025 Discord Channel or use the #RIFTLovelyDuo2025 hashtag on Facebook or X. 
5. Include both Character Names and Shard in your entry. 
6. And you are both set! 
 
[b]Are there any rules?[/b] 
 
1. Your screenshot can be old or new, but newer pictures are encouraged! 
2. Your entry must contain at least one another playable character (maximum 2 players per entry) and must adhere to the contest’s theme of Love. 
3. Content and submissions that may be inappropriate or offensive are strictly forbidden. 
4. Image editing is allowed, as long as the entry remains fully visible. 
5. Entries that do not include either Character Names or just one Character Name and Shard will not be eligible to receive a reward. 
6. Once you submit an entry, your significant other is not required to submit another entry and submitting multiple will not increase the chances of earning a prize. 
 
[b]What are the rewards?[/b] 
 
Up to three (3) entries will be eligible to receive 3000 Credits for both characters in the screenshot. 
 
Entry period will conclude on March 3, 2025, 22:59 UTC and winners will be announced on March 11, 2025. 

[b]A Lovely Giveaway![/b] ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/f31e42463a13ed09ac1e4ff817dc077789e4ecfa.jpg[/img]
Are you perhaps looking for a sweet new ride this Month of Love? Then we have a sweet treat for you! 
 
[b]How do I enter?[/b]
 
By simply participating in either A Lovely Home or A Lovely Duo you will be automatically entered in the raffle! 
 
[b]Is there anything I should know?[/b]
 
Should you participate in both contests, you will be eligible only for one raffle prize. 
Participating in both contests counts as 2 entries, one for each valid contest entry. 
 
[b]What is the reward?[/b] 
 
Up to three (3) contest participants will receive a Lovely Levitation mount! 
 
The contest runs along the two other contests until March 3, 2025, and the winners will be revealed on March 11, 2025. 

Head over to Telara, beloved Ascended, and show us what love truly means!

-

[b]12 Days of Telara! [/b]


On the first day of RIFTmas, Cyril gave to me!~ 
That’s right, 12 Days of Telara is back with daily reward for everyone to enjoy until December 27, 2024! 
Truly exciting, is it not? Then be sure to turn in here every day to discover what new gift await you!

[i]Note: Entry is required only once to be eligible for any raffle reward during 12 Days of Telara – submitting an entry multiple times with multiple characters and/or accounts is forbidden.[/i]

-

[b]Dimension Contest: A Cozy Winter Home 2024![/b]

The cold weather out there really got our hands in a cold predicament Ascended, and we need your help to warm our souls with some great Dimension decorations! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]

[olist]
[*] Head over to RIFT and pick out your favorite snowy or cozy dimension. 
[*] Decorate it to your heart’s desire, but keep it warm and cozy! 
[*] Take one or more screenshots of your Dimension and submit it to the #cozy-winter-home channel on Discord or use the #RIFTCozyHome hashtag on Facebook or X! 
[*] Include your Character Name and Shard in your entry. 
[*] And you’re set! 
[/olist]

[b]Are there any rules? [/b]

[olist]
[*] Your Dimension can be old or newly made; however, newly decorated dimensions are encouraged! 
[*] Your entry must adhere to the contest’s theme “Warm and Cozy”. 
[*] Content that may be inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden. 
[*] Minor image editing is allowed. 
[*] Entries that don’t include Character Name and Shard will not be able to receive a reward.
[/olist] 

[b]What are the rewards? [/b]

Up to three (3) Ascended will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits 
2nd place – Dimension Contest Second Place +3000 Credits 
3rd place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 3000 Credits 
 
The contest submission period will end on January 5, 2025 and winners will be announced on January 15, 2025! 
 
Rewards may take up to two (2) weeks to be delivered from the winner’s announcement.

-

[b]RIFTmas Trivia![/b]

The fun doesn’t end with daily gifts and beautiful dimensions! 
Throughout 12 Days of Telara you can now take part in a fun trivia challenge to test your knowledge! 
 
To participate, [url=https://forms.office.com/e/n1BGV0vjZ5]simply click here[/url]! 
 
Up to nine (9) participants will receive 1000 Credits each! 
Winners will be announced on December 30, 2024!

-

[b]Screenshot Contest: RIFTmas in the snow![/b]

And now it’s your time to flex your photography skills! 
Take the perfect screenshot that perfectly pictures the spirit of the holidays to win amazing rewards! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]
 
1. Head over to RIFT and take a screenshot that embodies the spirit of the holidays. 
2. One or more screenshots are allowed. 
3. Submit your entry to the #riftmas-in-the-snow channel on RIFT’s official Discord. 
4. Include your character Name, Shard and Region in your entry. 
5. And you’re good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Your screenshot must adhere to the contest’s theme of RIFTmas. 
2. More than just your character can be present in the screenshot, however only the participant who submitted an entry is eligible for a reward. (Multiple of the same entry from separate users are not eligible)

4. Entries that do not include Character Name, Shard and Region will not be eligible to receive a reward.

Up to three (3) Ascended will receive 3000 Credits each! 
 
The contest submission period will close on December 31, 2024 and winners will be announced on January 15, 2024.

notes.content:

Hello, Ascended! 
We would like to inform you that the PTS (Public Test Server) environment will open from August 8, 2024, until August 12, 2024! 
 
[b]What should I test on the PTS environment? [/b]
 
On the PTS environment, we simply require players to play as normal, while at the same time reporting which regular features of RIFT are experiencing issues, as well as any outstanding bugs that you may experience during gameplay. 
 
[b]Where can I report any bug I experience on PTS?[/b] 
 
There are currently three locations where you can report a bug: 
 
1. [url=https://canary.discord.com/channels/803951699626426399/1198943562667147294]The Official RIFT Discord’s feedback forum[/url], an official post made by a member of staff will be made here, titled “August 2024 PTS reports”.

3. Directly contact a Community Manager on Discord. 
 
Whichever location is your preference to report a bug, we kindly request you to provide as many details as possible! 
 
[b]How can I access the PTS environment?[/b] 
 
To access the PTS environment, please do the following: 
 
1. Open Glyph and select RIFT. 
2. Click on the cogwheel icon on the right side of the Play button. 
3. Select NewPTS – you may have to redownload RIFT. 
4. Click Play and enter PTS. 
 
[b]Keep an eye on Friday, August 9, 2024, for some PTS fun with CM Arcahem![/b] 
 
We would like to extend our gratitude to any of you fellow Ascended who participate in this PTS period with 7 days of Patron! 
See you on PTS! 
 
Your RIFT team.

notes.title: RIFT EU Shard Closure Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/f9a4e1d821f9bf0a321d6ea54303a6756df578d5.jpg[/img]

Hello, dear Ascended. 
 
We have some important news to share regarding the European Shards. 
On September 30, 2024, the European shard Bloodiron will be closed as part of our efforts to consolidate shards within the EU region. 
 
[b]Why are we closing the Shard? [/b]
 
Our goal is to make it easier for players in the European region to find fellow Ascended and embark on new adventures together. 
 
[b]What steps do I have to take if I am on Bloodiron? [/b]
 
1. If you are playing on the shard Bloodiron, please consider transferring to one of the following shards: Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria. 
2. Read the guide on how to transfer your character(s) to another shard [url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en-us/articles/203372878-RIFT-Character-Transfer-Overview][b]by clicking here[/b][/url]. 
3. Keep an eye on the official RIFT website for more details. 
 
[b]What happens if I do not transfer in time? [/b]
 
Characters that are not transferred to Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria before September 30, 2024, will become unavailable, and regular play will not be possible. We advise you to transfer to your preferred shard as soon as possible. 
 
[i]Please note that during this period, the character limit on the EU region will be lifted to facilitate transfers. [b]We recommend having no more than 14 characters on a single shard[/b]. If you exceed this limit, characters beyond the 14th will become inaccessible, and the only way to recover them is to delete some of your accessible characters. [/i]
 
We appreciate your continued support as we strive to ensure you can continue playing with other Ascended. 
 
Your RIFT team

notes.title: Important notice in regard to NA shards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/7e4a5bde96f771c82ed7faeabdfacc719210019d.jpg[/img]

Hello, Ascended, 
we would like to share some important news regarding the shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol following our initial shard closure announcement. 
 
Starting today, the shards previously closed will become available to transfer characters to active shards until December 10, 2024. 
 
[b]Which shards are becoming available, and can I play on them?[/b] 
 
The NA Shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol are becoming available, but you will not be able to play on them, only transferring will be available during this transfer period. 
 
[b]Which shards can I transfer to?[/b] 
 
The available destination shards are Deepwood, Wolfsbane, Greybriar and Laethys. 
 
[b]How do I transfer? [/b]
 
Transferring is simple:  
 
1. Log in with the Glyph account, where your characters are located. 
2. Select and open the shard where your characters are found. 
3. Select the character you wish to Transfer. 
4. Click on “Transfer”. 
5. Select any of the 4 available shards and confirm. 
6. Your character will now be on an active shard and will be playable again. 

[i]We are aware that characters that have mails on their character cannot transfer. Therefore, please reach out per ticket.[/i]
 
How long do I have to transfer? 
 
The period to transfer from Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol is six months (until December 10, 2024). 
 
[b]We advise all players to move as soon as possible before the transfer period concludes. [/b]
 
Your RIFT team.

[list]

        [*]b. Prepare your favorite vegan meal in RIFT, take a screenshot with your character clearly visible. 

        [*]c. Prepare your favorite vegan meal in real life and take a photo of it. 
[/list]
2) Submit your screenshot or photo in our [url=https://discord.gg/TbCEpnSKvV]Discord[/url].

Your RIFT Team✨

[url=#carnivalevent][*]Carnival Event[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/c2f9cfc2a495bc26eb691ab290ce063e61475dae.png[/img]

[h3=budgiemadness]Budgie Madness[/h3]

The cute, colorful, and amazing [b]Budgies[/b] are back for [b]two weeks[/b]!
It’s time to collect all your [b]Chaos Motes[/b] to get lovely rewards like [b]Wardrobe Skins[/b], [b]Pets[/b], [b]Dimension Items[/b], or [b]Mounts[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/21439ca15d614334a21fea45b139da3c657996d4.gif[/img]

[i]Complete an expert dungeon through Groupfinder (LFG) and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes! [/i]

[b]2. Birds of a Feather Train Together [/b]
[i]Press K to open the PvP window and queue up for a Warfront, win it and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes! [/i]

[b]3. Off to the Races[/b]
[i]Pick up the quest for the Budgie race and complete it to be rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes![/i]

[b]4. For the Birds [/b]
[i]In Silverwood, Freemarch, Shimmersand, Stillmoor, and Vostigar Peaks will be a Special Budgie Zone Event called ‘The Birds’. Complete the Event and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes. [/i]

Discover new daily quests on NPC ‘[b]Frank Stroher[/b]’. 

Each quest gives [b]15 Chaos Motes[/b]. One available per day. 
 
Budgie Wisp 
Budgie Spirit 
Lost Hatchling 
Budgie Mare 
Mystical Hatchling 
Test Budgie 
Test Crow 
Energy Stone 
Lost Medallio 
Void Conductor

Get more details about the cute Budgies on the following community page: 
 
[url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/call-to-action/budgies/]CADRIFT – Budgies[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/5c2d1b6592232d90391c1d0383572dda3d19f7b3.png[/img]

Grab your [b]Carnival Mask[/b] and get ready to celebrate [b]11 years with us on RIFT[/b].  
Beautiful decorations await you in all major [b]cities[/b]! Go on weekly or daily quests within the next [b]four weeks[/b] and get rewarded with Loot Bags, Mounts, and more! You can also collect [b]Carnival Prize Tickets[/b]. These tickets are awarded for completing a [b]Carnival Game[/b]. They can be redeemed in the World Event section of the[b] RIFT Store[/b] for special prizes. 
 
[b]Weekly Quest[/b]

Talk to Dantwor Honey-Tongue at the docks in Tempest Bay to accept the weekly quest called “Clean House at the Carnival”. You need to complete 50 Carnival mini-games and will be rewarded with 2 Auroral Doubloons that can be exchanged in the Carnival shop for other rewards and one Carnival Celebration Crate. 

  
[b]Mini Games[/b]

There are various repeatable mini-games such as the very popular Balloon Stomp. If you want to play it please refer to the [url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/carnival/quests/]Balloon Jumping Etiquette[/url]. 

  
[b]Daily Quests[/b]

Among other activities, you can take part in daily quests like Frog Wrangling or visit Sijay Creg in your home city for additional quests to complete 5 Carnival Instant Adventures. 
 
You can also find more details on the following community page: 

[url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/carnival/quests/]CADRIFT – Carnival[/url]

Spring is also joining the party, and you will be able to celebrate the spring festival with numerous themed items such as various bunny ears or special clothing.  
 
[b]Bunny Ears[/b]
Get the costume pieces for your character and celebrate spring with us.

notes.title: Carnival of the Ascended 2021!
notes.content:
Greetings, Ascended!

Celebrate with us the Carnival of the Ascended 2021, marking the 10th anniversary of the release of Rift. The World Event will start on March 25th and will last 4 weeks, until April 22nd, 2021 at 15.30.00 local server time.

The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 25th of March
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 15th of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 22nd of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]End of the event[/b]: Thursday 29th of April at 15.30.00 local server time


What can you look forward to?


[b]New Artifact Sets[/b]

• Added three new Artifact sets. Collecting each one will be rewarded a Celebration Chest containing, among other items, 4 Auroral Doubloons!

Our Overlord
- Completing a 4-hour Carnival Minion Mission has a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Overlords that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Hero Generation
- Among the rewards for killing one of the Carnival IA bosses, players will receive a Celebration Bag for Adventurers that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Pinata Candy
- Hunt Pinatas across Telara for a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Pinata Hunters that will grant a random artifact of this set.

• Collect and complete all the three new artifact sets to earn the True Veteran achievement, which will give the "Elder" prefix title and 100 platinum.


[b]New Minion[/b]

• Uncover the story of the old Ascended Trillian Lockwert by acquiring its Minion Card
- Upon collecting it, a chain of 11 Minion Missions will be unlocked. Complete them all to acquire 5 new Minions, 4 collectible journal entries with Trillians story, and some additional Carnival of the Ascended currency!
- Get the full group to level 25 to unlock the "Long-lived" suffix Title through an achievement.


[b]Updated LootTables[/b]

• The Pinata Prize Bags obtained in Carnival IAs can now drop some of the pets added during the Carnival of the Ascended in 2020!


[b]New Items[/b]

• Support your faction! Obtain one of the Guardian Valmeras or the Defiant Warhorses with Auroral Doubloons or Credits to show your support and unlock an exclusive title through an achievement.

• Complement your faction looks with the Ascended Guardian or Defiant Wings. Or be a proud Telaran with the Tenth Anniversary Cape.

• The new Tenth Anniversary Cake will grant you a raid consumable granting 100 Endurance and it was modeled after the real Rift Release Cake that the studio made 10 years ago for the launch! Also available as a Dimensional item to sweeten your home.

• Ever wanted to trick others to be Unicorns and join your cavalry? The Fancy Celebration Cake can be placed for everyone to turn into Carnival Unicorns and ride along with you and will grant a special achievement with a vanity unlock: the Celebration Ruff!


[b]Fixes[/b]

• Store - Fixed an issue with older Carnival Dimensional items not appearing unless all class types were selected.

• Dimension - Floating Platform Device no longer duplicates itself visually when rotating the item in a dimension.

• Mystic Archer - Legendary Ride the Wind now reduces the cast time of Summoning Quiver as expected.

• Oracle - Prevented an exploit where Legendary Insignia of Blood could be triggered with non-damaging abilities.


What are you waiting for? Come and celebrate with us! Happy birthday, Rift!

notes.title: Fae Yule 2020 has arrived!
notes.content:
Get ready for the most festive time of the year in Telara! Greatfather Frost has arrived and brings back Fae Yule for 2020!

The World Event begins today, [b]December 10, 2020 at 3.30 PM local server time[/b] and will conclude on [b]Thursday, January 7, 2021 at 3.30 PM local server time[/b].

Participate in the Fae Yule festivities to earn [b]Unique Snowflakes[/b] and [b]Dark Icicles[/b] to obtain all the new items!


[b]Fae Yule 2020[/b]
What awaits you in this year's Fae Yule event? See below!


The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 17th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 24th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]End of the event[/b]: Thursday 7th of January at 15.30.00 local server time


The Fae Yule Store will be active from:
- [b]Start[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 08.05.00 local server time
- [b]End[/b]: Thursday 14th of January at 08.00.00 local server time


[b]Adjustments[/b]
The price of previous year's pets and minions has been lowered permanently.


[b]New Essences[/b]
Push the limits of your essences with the new Seraphic Zephyr and Seraphic Torrent Unique essences, with a focus on each of the main stats.
Shadowpriest (WIS), Shadowcaller (INT), Shade Stalker (DEX), and Death Knight (STR) versions are available.


[b]New Vanity and Mounts[/b]
The Fae whisper about the evil alchemist that lurks in the dark hunting those boglings that have misbehaved this year. Remind them about their folk tales with the Nebulous Omen Cape or the Infinity Flask vanity items.

Always loved the starry nights in Telara? The new Astral Wings and the Astral Voyager levitation mount are here to immortalize its beauty! But if you prefer to see the stars by yourself, get on top of the Mighty Woolly Explorer, our new mount, and travel to the highest mountains to enjoy the view. Remember to stay warm though, or you will end up looking like our new Icy Levitation, a special levitation that makes you frosty!


[b]New Minions[/b]
Welcome Mr.Quackers and Leah the Cool to the roster of minions! These two old pals are still looking for their long lost friend Frosty Paws.
Collect both minions to unlock the exclusive title "Winter Spirit" and level them both to level 15 to unlock the minion "Frosty Paws"!


[b]New Pets[/b]
The forecast from the Icewatch was correct. This winter is going to be one of the coldest in Telara, and the patrols are starting to find out all kinds of frozen creatures.
Consider adopting one to warm it up? The new frozen pet set is available! Collect Flurry, Snowfall, Drift, Avalanche, Slush, Tundra, Powder, Glacier, Sleet or Rime!


Happy holidays, Ascended!

notes.title: Let's Celebrate 20 Years of gamigo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/a10cb671e9909236af7f6535291233af9aa29449.jpg[/img]

gamigo is turning 20 years old! 20 years of memories, ups and downs, friendships, soulmates, enemies and kinship. We would like to share our happiness with you all in the form of events, challenges, social media and forum activities, and much more! There will be tons of chances to win some amazing prizes, such as gaming devices, hoodies and thousands of Euros of in-game currencies across our dozens of games!

Since this is the perfect opportunity to show you all how much you mean to us, we will also have a very special tiered reward system with special bundles. Every time we hit a goal you will be rewarded for your favorite games. Our communities make us the amazing gaming company we are today, we never could have done any of it without you! You all make this a gaming family; you are the heart and soul of this 20th anniversary celebration. Thank you!


[u][b]All that is happening:[/b][/u]

[i][u]Anniversary Points – Win cool stuff![/u][/i]
You can win Anniversary points in weekly challenges and screen shots event and via voucher codes!

[i][u]Challenges[/u][/i]
Compete in server challenges and be the best of your game to win anniversary points. The first one has already started, check it out [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-administration-staff/rift-administrators/513041-20-years-gamigo-first-challenge.html]here[/url]!

[u][i]Screen Shots[/i][/u]
Mimic the posted screen shot and win anniversary points. The first one has already started, check it out [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-administration-staff/rift-administrators/513033-screenshot-challenge-recipe-1-perfect-place.html]here[/url]!

[u][i]Vouchers[/i][/u]
Watch in-game, social media pages, Discord chats, and forums for surprise vouchers codes. There is no rhyme nor reason to when or where they will pop-up. They will only pop-up in one location at a time, so keep your eyes peeled for them. The first 10 players to redeem the voucher will earn 500 Anniversary Points, the small gift is yours to keep of course! Be quick and don’t miss out.

[u][i]What can I win?[/i][/u]
Gather the most anniversary points to rank in the leaderboard for your game. If you manage to stay on the leaderboard by the time the event is fully finished, you will receive a cool prize and be entered into a raffle for a Mouse and Keyboard bundle as well as game cash for your game.

Want to keep an eye on your points? Then [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]watch [/url]the Leaderboard!

[u][i]Special Bundles with a kick![/i][/u]
Special Shop Bundles have been created and each purchase helps progress the bar towards a goal to earn cool prizes or events that can be received and enjoyed by everyone!

Check out the Bundles in game!

Special bundle purchases from all games will help move the bar.


These are the fun things you can unlock:

[b]Level 1[/b]
2 Greater Experience Vials
2 Great Favor Vials

[b]Level 2[/b]
3 Dark Levitation Supply Crate

[b]Level 3[/b]
1 Cache of Individual Reward Charges
5 Tenebrean Planar Attuner

[b]Level 4[/b]
1 Fabulous Moosedantix


View the progress of the bundle tiers anytime on the [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]Anniversary Website[/url]!

[u][i]Share your moments[/i][/u]
Share with us your most memorable moment from any gamigo game for the past 20 years
OR
Wish us a happy birthday!


Wanna know how, check out the [url=https://20th.gamigo.net/en/shareyourmoment.html]website[/url]!


[u][b]Important Information:[/b][/u]

[i][u]Winners[/u][/i]
Winners will be published at the end of the month when all events have ended, and everything tallied. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we take the time to ensure everything is counted properly before we announce the winner.

[u][i]Anniversary Point Ranking and Bundle Progression[/i][/u]
The Anniversary Point rankings and Special Bundle progression bar will not be auto updated, they will be updated once per normal workday to reflect the goings on from the past hours. We do not have an exact time this will happen, nor do we guarantee it will happen over the weekend. Only the top 50 users on the rankings will be visible, and rankings will be split per game. All point totals for all users, even those not in the top 50, will still be saved.

[u][i]Rankings[/i][/u]
Names in the rankings will be displayed with asterisks blocking all except the first and last letter of the ranked party’s name (for example O****N instead of ORION). There will be a voucher item available to anyone who wants/agrees to have their full name displayed in the ranking on the anniversary. By using the voucher item, you will be agreeing to have your full character name available to everyone who views the page: [b]SHOWYOURNAME20RIFT[/b]
The name that will be displayed in the ranking, will be the name of the first character you login on you account, after redeeming the  SHOWYOURNAME20RIFT voucher. 

[u][i]Frequently Asked Questions[/i][/u]
Visit our [url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en/articles/360054828194-20-gamigo-Jubil%C3%A4um]FAQ[/url] for more information!


[b]Rules of participation for contests[/b]
1. Everyone who participates must be at least 18 years old.
2. Employees of gamigo AG or their relatives, and Game Masters or their relatives are not allowed to participate.
3. Participants will be entered to win the prizes mentioned in the event description.
4. If gamigo has reasonable suspicion of the violation of these rules, then gamigo reserves the possibility to exclude those persons from participating. In those cases, it’s possible to revoke prizes afterwards and draw a new winner.
5. The prize cannot be transferred to another person and cannot be paid as cash. gamigo reserves the right to replace single prizes with equivalent or superior prizes. It’s not possible to give prizes to underage persons.
6. If there are disagreements regarding the rules, the process or results of the raffle, then the decision made by gamigo is final. It is not subject to legal recourse.
7. The data is confidential and will be handled by gamigo according to the legal data protection regulations.

notes.title: EU Live Shard Merges – July 11, 2019
notes.content:
Greetings, Ascended!

The EU server merge will start on July 11, 2019 at [b]7 AM (PT)/ 9 AM (CT) / 4 PM (CEST)[/b] and the downtime may last up to 8 hours. For live updates, please check out our [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/general-discussions/shard-status/508988-eu-shard-merges-7-00-am-pst-2-00-pm-utc-july-11-2019-a.html?_ga=2.98753182.149724838.1562571147-566007447.1549879410]forum[/url].

[b]Shards to be merged:[/b]

[list][*] Skelf (Hidden) / Refuge / Zaviel / Gelidra –> Typhiria[/list]

[b]After it’s all been completed, the European cluster will consist of:[/b]

[list][*] Bloodiron (PVP)
[*] Brutwacht (German)
[*] Brisesol (French)
[*] Typhiria (English / xChat Host)
[*] Cahail (Hidden Instance Host)[/list]

[h1][b]Good to know:[/b][/h1]
[list][*] [b]What happened with the previous shard merge attempts?[/b]
[list][*] The past attempts to merge the shards failed due to unforeseen issues with the tool used. This tool, which had to be rewritten, was tested on our PTS. Huge Thank You! to everyone who took the time to test it![/list]
[*] [b]Why is it happening during EU prime time?[/b]
[list][*] The team that built the tool is located in the US, so it’s being done during a time where they could troubleshoot potential issues.[/list]
[*] [b]Considering the merge downtimes, will there be a compensation?[/b]
[list][*] Yes! Compensation packs will be issued during the end of July or beginning of August.[/list][/list]
 

[i]Answers to your previous questions can be found [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/general-discussions/news-announcements/508528-eu-live-shard-merges-4.html?_ga=2.98753182.149724838.1562571147-566007447.1549879410#post5376745]here[/url] and [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/general-discussions/news-announcements/508528-eu-live-shard-merges-10.html?_ga=2.98753182.149724838.1562571147-566007447.1549879410#post5377530]there[/url][/i]

notes.title: Autumn Harvest: Extended
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/d7ab9e0ad49de66179f4920d9b3e7ab27c2c5385.jpg[/img]

Update - Autumn Harvest is being extended an extra week and will now run through November 14, 2018!

Cool breezes and brightly colored leaves usher in Autumn Harvest starting today, October 18th! Wings, heads and tails. [b]Tails?[/b] YES, we've introduced our very first tail item in RIFT!

Take a half dozen toxic spores from the Xarth Mire, mix in some devious beasties, swirl them together with toxic miasma and just like that, we're ready for the season of spirits!

Claim Lady Glasya's wings in the RIFT Store on Live or Prime! These pinions are loaded with dark power, and are served up in both cosmetic and mount versions in the pack, offering you flexibility in your pairings! [b]This just in: you may also choose Lady Glasya's TAIL from the pack, the very first tail item ever offered in RIFT![/b]

Noxious Levitation will leave a cloud of poisonous ruin in your wake as you travel across Telara. They will be offered for Credits on Live and a consumable version for event currency on Prime.

We'll have more images of the terrific new items next week and will feature them on the October 19th Livestream, where Autumn Harvest and Extra-Life share the stage! Please join [url=https://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donorDrive.team&teamID=39909][b]Team Trion[/b][/url] in supporting the Children's Miracle Network Hospitals to help the wee ones who cannot help themselves! Even $5 helps more than you could imagine. Together with our Trion creators, we've raised almost $400,000 for Extra-Life over the past eight years... help us take it even further.

 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/9608a433affcd57838a44b1f7c850e6522dd767c.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]Lady Glasya is only too happy to share her wings with you this year! (Concept art)[/u][/h1]
 

[b]AUTUMN HARVEST RUNS OCTOBER 18th through November 8th, 2018[/b]

We have some amazing new items for you to chase this year in our traditional Autumn Harvest festivities! This event is presented on both Live and Prime servers, and you begin your adventures in Meridian or Sanctum, as ever.

 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/912c052a5e384b5edb4538c842bf8b26ddb63d2f.jpg[/img]


 

All of the below may be earned in game by the most dedicated of Autumnal celebrants:

 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Broadsword[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Corseque[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Stormcaller[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Warbow[/*]
 	[*]Top them off with the Noxious Rune for the complete effect![/*]
[/list]

[/list]
 

[b]The ghastliest backpack looks for the season:[/b]
[list]

[/list]
 

[b]Wardrobe additions to haunt you:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Deathly Witch's Hat[/*]
 	[*]Frightening Jack-O-Lantern Mask[/*]
 	[*]Orphiel Mask[/*]
 	[*]Soul Reaper's Cowl[/*]
 	[*]Demonic Clown Mask[/*]
 	[*]Demonic Nightmare Helm[/*]

notes.title: Fires of Maelforge Power Pack
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/cdfb13599bdada0de43180cc477aadcb58b81600.jpg[/img]

AVAILABLE ON THE STEAM STORE NOW!
A pack with two meeeeeeelion Loyalty points... yeah, we thought that'd catch your eye!

This is one of the best packs we have ever offered in RIFT. The hulking, menacing Maelforge Broodling Mount alone is worth it, but we also include a huge 40-slot bag (we know you need it!) and the Forgemaster's Inferno Costume helm.

[b]All for just $29.99![/b]

Did we mention the [b]2,000,000* Loyalty points[/b]? Swoop in and level up your Loyalty Tier before this limited time sale ends!

Note: The Estrodian Wings - those creepy leathery flappers with demonic eyebooglers - are not included in this pack... but we know where you can get them: the RIFT In-game store, for 3,150 credits! This includes both the cosmetic and mount version of the wings!

We want to thank Trion Creator [b]Celyne[/b] for the gorgeous image included above. She was as inspired by the Maelforge Power Pack as we hope you will be! Follow [b]@ArtByCelyne[/b] on Twitter and be constantly amazed by the glorious game-inspired work she creates!

 

Here is the Maelforge Broodling mount and Inferno Helm in game:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/71ea129dcaa8f20f6883ac83a7c41a42e397d23a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Defiance 2050 Invades RIFT Aug 2 – Aug 6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/7144a355d9ec622e5865a1b64eecf65508e9be17.jpg[/img]

Hellbugs have invaded Telara! Get in there and save the world, Ascended!

Prevent these Hellbugs from their aggressive colonization of Telara. These suspiciously familiar invaders have jumped from the other worldly city of San Francisco to Telara to try and make it their home. Don’t let them gain a foothold as they spread from one end of Mathosia to the other.

[B]Call-to-Action Event[/B]

From Thursday, August 2, 2018 beginning at 12:01 AM PDT until Monday, August 6, 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT, Hellbugs from Defiance 2050 will invade RIFT! During this limited-time event, Hellbug Rifts will spawn more frequently throughout Telara (on both Live and Prime). Additionally, new zones have been added to their rampage, including Scarwood Reach, Shimmersand, Iron Pine Peak, and Ember Isle.

Participating in this Call to Action event can net you some unique prizes. Completing these Hellbug Rifts have a chance to award you:
[LIST]
[*] Minor XP or Token Boosts (15%)
[*] Bonus Currency
[*] Special Dimension Items
[*] Minions (Live only)

notes.title: The Next Big Prime Update is Here! Introducing 4.5!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/48a87a5388780be03d1dfc4df50a945cef9066e3.jpg[/img]

It’s Prime time to play RIFT Prime, now that our next big update, 4.5 is here!

Beginning July 11, 2018, RIFT Prime is updated to 4.5, which includes tons of new content like quests, onslaughts, new gear, planar attunement, class balance updates, and much, much more!

[h1]Ember Isle[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/539b8590eb38e4f74fb912436fb279f8125cc154.jpg[/img]

The long awaited Ember Isle is ready to explore on Prime. Considered by many to be one of RIFT’s most beautiful zones, this lush tropical paradise is home to the Farclan Dwarves and the Kelari who battle for the resources of the island. And in the center the menacing presence to Mount Cacera an active volcano, what secrets lie in its heart.
[list]
 	[*]Over 30 new quests[/*]
 	[*]More than a dozen new Rifts[/*]
 	[*]Over 20 more achievements[/*]
 	[*]More than 15 new rare creatures to track down[/*]
 	[*]More zone events[/*]
 	[*]Even a new zone puzzle - all the things you expect from a full-featured RIFT zone[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Introducing Onslaughts for Prime[/h1]

When the fissures known as the Sourcewells first appeared, it was quickly realized that these founts of energy were like a bountiful feed trough for the planar invaders on the island. Many Kelari found themselves called to take up the mantle of the five heroes and guard the Sourcewells. They built the defenses and, to this day, remain at their posts, giving their very lives to deny this food to the enemy.
[list]
 	[*]Take a defensive position and get ready for battle[/*]
 	[*]Upgrade the Lifesprings and Turrets to give yourself the best chance of survival[/*]
 	[*]Improve your power against the plains by upgrading the Dense Arch at the center of each Sourcewell[/*]
 	[*]Earn the respect of the Keepers and gain access to their merchants[/*]
[/list]
[h1]New Treasures in Caduceus Rise[/h1]

Caduceus, a powerful Telaran Sprit, has been corrupted by energy from the Plane of Earth. The Kelari built a temple at Caduceus Rise to honor this sprit where they would offer him gifts in exchange for boons. This was long ago in the past. Today, the Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple. They have been haggling with Caduceus.

Meanwhile Laethys has been transported through The Plan of Fire to Ember Isle in the form of golden treasure from the hardened liquid gold in Chalmers Caldera. Her spirit was torn in the journey, and fragments of her soul became bound to objects of wealth scattered about Ember Isle.

The Golden Maw formed an agreement with Caduceus for the spirit to use its powerful Earth magic to help reform Laethys a corporal dragon. Will the Ascended be able to stop this diabolical plan before it’s too late?
[list]
 	[*]The Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple at Caduceus Rise, built by the Kelari to honor the powerful Telaran spirit, Caduceus.[/*]
 	[*]In their ongoing efforts to give Laethys a corporeal form, her cult followers have made an agreement with Caduceus to lend his powerful Earth magic to their cause.[/*]
 	[*]By negating Caduceus' assistance, the Ascended buy more time against Laethys' attempts to return to full strength on Telara.[/*]
 	[*]Both Expert Caduceus Rise and Expert Upper Caduceus Rise will be available.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Planar Attunement Now on Prime[/h1]

Worthy Guardians are granted these powers through a ritual with the Messenger of the Vigil and the great piece of sourcestone in the heart of Sanctum. The Ascended is said to have been brought closer to The Vigil and thus able to interact with planar energies in a manner more akin to that of the Vigil.

For the Defiants, a new machine was constructed by Sylver Valis that would attune them to The Planes more closely. Defiant Ascended were returned in bodies made of sourcestone. Sylver's machine attunes this sourcestone to the planes from which it was created.
[list]
 	[*]Planar Attunements provide base enhancements to your character's Calling from each Plane, and is not Soul-specific.[/*]
 	[*]Your experience bar will turn into a Planar Attunement meter when you reach level 50. The mouseover tooltip will indicate that you are earning experience toward Planar Attunement.[/*]
 	[*]You must purchase all Planar Attunement abilities of a given tier before you can begin spending points in the next tier up. More tiers will be unlocked in future updates.[/*]
 	[*]Rested experience does not apply to post-level-50 Planar Attunement experience.[/*]
[/list]

To learn more about all the changes in the 4.5 update, check out the [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-prime-vigil-discussion-reading-anyone-posting-patron-only/prime-vigil-patch-notes/505587-rift-4-5-update-7-11-2018-a.html]patch notes for Prime here[/url]. Then, don’t forget to give us feedback on this update in ththis thread. If you’ve left Prime, now is the perfect time to return and enjoy all this new content.

notes.title: Grim Remembrance
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/03ddeef328a749af9ec83c34b26325acdc07fd7d.jpg[/img]

Alsbeth has waited far too long for the River of Souls to open in Telara. Find out what secrets she has planned…

From Wednesday, July 11, 2018 at 8:30 AM PDT until Wednesday, July 25, 2018 at 8:00 AM PDT, participate in a long-anticipated series of zone events in Silverwood, Freemarch, Gloamwood, Stonefield, Stillmoor, and Shimmersand, along with some daily quests. Take part in the event to earn in-game rewards such as cosmetics, trinkets, and (Prime-only) gear. This is the prelude to the River of Souls raid, coming soon to RIFT Prime!

[h1]What is The Grim Remembrance?[/h1]

The Grim Remembrance is when the Ascended mark the first of the recent apocalypses that have beset our world, when a mad cult leader would have succeeded in destroying all that exists on behalf of the Blood Storm, but for the timely intercession of a raid of Ascended who stopped their plans. Things may be a little colder than the usual weather in Summerfest, a bit gloomier. It's not as joyful as Fae Yule, but the Ascended always mark the moment upon the parapets of Caer Mathos when time stood still, and the world was saved.

This event will take place on both RIFT Live and Prime. For RIFT Prime, this will be the event leading up to the River of Souls raid unlock. For players on RIFT Live, this will be a chance to take part in a reimagined take on the original event.

[h1]Who is Alsbeth the Discordant?[/h1]

Alsbeth the Discordant was the first of the cult leaders to reveal herself since the Ascended appeared on Telara. In life, she had always sought power, be it befriending Asha Catari, the most powerful mage of her class at Quicksilver College, by moving up the social ladder in the court of King Jostir, or by choosing the side she thought she would have the most to gain from when rebellion broke out against Aedraxis. But it was only in death when her true destructive nature imperiled all of Telara. While the heroes of Telara were brought back to life as Guardians of the Vigil, or traveled back in time as the Defiant heralds of the end times, Alsbeth had returned in secret as the handmaid of Regulos, the Destroyer.

She had played her part well at first, pretending that her ascension was just like all the other miracles of the gods or science, when in truth she was returned to the World of Telara as part of an unholy deal with the dragon of death to bring an end to all things. But the Ascended do not suffer villains lightly, and time after time her plans were thwarted. From the conquest of Freemarch to the corruption of Gloamwood, the Ascended stopped her schemes and spells at every turn. Even her supply chain of sourcestone from Scarlet Gorge was shut down. If she was to make good upon the many promises she made to that unforgiving dragon, she would have to conquer the Ascended and destroy the world in one fell swoop. By unleashing the dead upon Telara, its former heroes and villains, monsters and protectors, she hoped she would cause time to stand still and in the confusion strike a blow against the Ascended that would break the ward and bring her master Regulos back from destruction and into an everlasting night of the Plane of Death.

If you missed out before, this is your chance to experience the reimagined Grim Remembrance! If you’re a new player on Prime, join this exciting event to find out what’s to come on Prime. Have something to say? Post it here!
